title: DuckStation 0.1-11026: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-11026 on April 11, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-11026 on April 11, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: bdd796c6d FileSystem: Remove GetDisplayNameFromPath(). ed7261d9e Atualização Português do Brasil ( 3708). bbd36606d Cheats: Drop extern from declarations. cd539c0cf Deps: Update to 20260404.
